sourceMapping: Introduction is section 1, printed chapter I is section 2, XLVII is section 48. Final review is section 49. Slot counting is one-based. Section grouping identifiers intentionally retained byte-for-byte.
dedication: Dedication from Gutenberg 3207, from TO MY MOST HONOR’D FRIEND through Paris APRILL 15/25 1651. Keep optional supplement separate; do not add a numbered chapter or silently renumber reader positions.
apparatus: Both witness maps retained. Modernised marginal labels may be inline, combined, embedded in the first clause, or stand in the preceding reader slot; automatic Molesworth locations are approximate, not new insertion instructions. Repeated page headings in the Review and editorial advertisement excluded.

textualNotes.note: Virgil, Aeneid VI.578–579: normalised ligatures from Molesworth; aetherium rather than aethereum.
Hobbes cites the received text of 1 John 5 (including the Johannine Comma); preserve his actual argument, not an unmarked substitution from a modern critical Bible.
Corrected the Modern editions’ king to Childeric III (historical witness; original transcribed text remains unchanged).
Joash was Atalja’s grandson, not her son.
The dove at the baptism descended on Jesus, as distinct from Christ later breathing on his disciples.
Recovered omitted transition contrasting Moses’ announcement of governing laws with those appointed to execute sentences.
Recovered “without express law or commission”; updated references to cover witness striking first and full proceeding. Danish Deuteronomy numbering differs from English by one verse at chapter 13.
